lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement consists of high-luminance nodes organized in approximately four longitudinal rows along the lateral flank. The central rows exhibit a staggered spatial distribution forming a repeating geometric grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Narrow vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice structure of high-contrast anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal intensity gradient is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a light-colored ridge line with distinct shadowing on the ventral aspect, extending towards the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated on the anterior and medial surfaces of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The distal tip of the lower caudal lobe shows a distinct localized increase in luminance (white tip), and a dark, elongated pigment feature is visible on the posterior section of the upper caudal lobe.
